Name: Donkey as Horse
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod change the Horse with a Donkey.
The mod has its own Stable, but you can download the optional file that do not change the stable.
This mod can be combined with Shrek Mod Set ([url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14957]Shrek's House[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14959]Shrek's Swamp[/url]).
The Costum Stable can be painted from Carpenter's Shop.



[size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=4]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels
